findings: Expanded RU and EN step overviews wrap cleanly at320px, expose their real numbered sequence and visibly highlight the current step.
Collapsed fact and activity overviews retain readable preview composition; question, selected answers and calm feedback have no overlap.
Optional source metadata preserves multiline copy and readable citations.
limitations: These are actual admin editor component captures, not mobile-app or authenticated staff-shell screenshots.
Viewport slices do not show every control at once; long fact citations continue beyond the captured viewport.
Existing shared admin preview metadata and sequential navigation labels remain Russian when viewing English authored copy; full bilingual shell acceptance is not claimed.
Desktop read-error notice is an intentional fixture, and citation metadata is synthetic and unverified.
